structured.answer: The current account seems to cost up to 10 ₪ a month (basic track), and under the new rule 5–10 ₪ by number of actions; keep in it what you need for spending, since above 15,000 ₪ for a quarter the bank must suggest alternatives — but I'm not sure which rule applies now, so I'll ask my son or the bank before changing anything.
